test_coverage_notes: The code in CanonicalTXSet.cpp is typically tested via higher-level transaction processing and ledger tests, such as those in 'test/ledger/CanonicalTXSet_test.cpp', 'test/app/tx/TransactionQueue_test.cpp', or integration tests that exercise transaction ordering and queuing. Direct unit tests for insert, popAcctTransaction, and ordering logic may exist, but edge cases (e.g., malformed AccountID, invalid sequence proxies, or salt collisions) may not be fully covered. There is no explicit validation of input data in this file; it relies on upstream validation (e.g., STTx construction and transaction submission). Gaps may exist in testing for unusual or malicious input, especially around accountKey salt handling and sequence/ticket edge cases.
